name: Please Be Quiet Frisco 2019

venue.name: [Hampton Inn & Suites Dallas/Frisco North-FieldhouseUSA](https://hamptoninn3.hilton.com/en/hotels/texas/hampton-inn-and-suites-dallas-frisco-north-fieldhouseusa-DALFFHX/index.html?SEO_id=GMB-HP-DALFFHX)
venue.address: 6070 Sports Village Road, Frisco, Texas, 75033, USA

information:
Everyone is welcome to compete but remember that this competition does not have events like 2x2, 3x3 and 4x4. It consists of the blindfolded events, 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, and 3x3x3 One-Handed.

Please submit 3x3x3 cubes for 3x3x3 Multi-Blind during registration so that staff can finish scrambling before the start of 3x3x3 Multi-Blind session.
Please also submit 4x4x4 cube for 4x4x4 Blindfolded during lunch time so that staff can scramble the 1st attempt for 4x4x4 Blindfolded in advance.
